items.headline: LeBron spoils ring night — the new-look 76ers beat the champ Knicks in his Philly debut
items.body: The Knicks raised their championship banner at the Garden… and then watched LeBron James spoil the party. In his Philadelphia debut, LeBron put up a tidy 14 points, 9 rebounds and 7 assists while Tyrese Maxey poured in a game-high 28, and the 76ers rallied past New York 106-100 on opening night. Jalen Brunson's 21 wasn't enough for the champs. Not bad for a guy still doing this at 41.
items.say: LeBron made his 76ers debut on opening night and they went into the Garden and beat the champion Knicks — on the night New York got their rings, no less. The guy's 41 and still going. You going to follow any hoops this year?

items.headline: From 22 down to a 23-0 run — the Pistons pull off a wild comeback over the Celtics
items.body: The craziest result of opening night was in Detroit. The Pistons were down 22, looked cooked… and then flipped it with a jaw-dropping 23-0 run late, Duncan Robinson catching fire off the bench, to stun the Celtics 121-113. ESPN says it's Detroit's biggest comeback against Boston in 30 years. One of those 'if you turned it off early, you missed it' nights.
items.say: The Pistons were down 22 to the Celtics and came all the way back on a 23-0 run to win — total chaos on opening night. You ever leave a game early and then see the comeback on your phone?

items.headline: A six-goal thriller in Paris — PSG edge Barcelona 4-2 in the game of the week
items.body: The heavyweight everyone circled delivered. PSG and Barcelona traded blows in a wild one — teenage star Lamine Yamal leveled it at 2-2 for Barça before Vitinha and Fabián Ruiz struck late to win it 4-2 for the European champions. PSG became the first team to beat Barcelona all season, and it had the feel of a Champions League final preview.
items.say: PSG and Barcelona played a 4-2 classic in the Champions League — PSG scored twice late to win it, and it already felt like a final preview. You keep up with the European stuff, or just the big finals?

links.text: NBC Sports — PSG 4-2 Barcelona: goals & reaction

items.headline: Anfield bedlam — Liverpool come from 2-0 down to win a 4-3 rollercoaster
items.body: If you like drama, this was the one. Villarreal raced 2-0 up early at Anfield, then Liverpool flipped it into a seven-goal rollercoaster — Alexis Mac Allister with two, Florian Wirtz on the scoresheet, and teenager Rio Ngumoha sparking the comeback — to win 4-3 and make it three wins from three in Europe. Absolute heart-attack football.
items.say: Liverpool went 2-0 down to Villarreal and came back to win a 4-3 madhouse at Anfield — a teenager off the bench sparked it. That's the kind of game that takes ten years off you. You a Liverpool guy, or just enjoy the chaos?

items.headline: Series on the line in Atlanta — Dream host Valkyries for a pivotal Game 3 tonight
items.body: The WNBA Finals are tied 1-1 and the scene shifts south: the Atlanta Dream host the upstart Golden State Valkyries tonight for their first-ever home Finals game, moved to the big State Farm Arena so 17,000-plus can pack in. Angel Reese and the Dream carry the momentum after that Game 2 blowout — now it's a best-of-five with home court finally in play.
items.say: The WNBA Finals are tied up and Game 3's tonight in Atlanta — Angel Reese's crew against that scrappy Golden State expansion team. It's been a really fun series. You catch any of the W this year?

items.headline: The 'Coraline' studio goes big — LAIKA's hand-crafted epic 'Wildwood' opens Friday
items.body: The stop-motion wizards at LAIKA (Coraline, Kubo) are back with their first film in years: 'Wildwood' hits theaters Friday (Oct. 23). Directed by Travis Knight and voiced by Carey Mulligan, Mahershala Ali and Jacob Tremblay, it follows a girl chasing her baby brother into a magical, dangerous forest on the edge of Portland. At 140 minutes it's reportedly the longest stop-motion film ever made — every frame built by hand.
items.say: The studio that did Coraline has a big new stop-motion movie called 'Wildwood' out Friday — apparently the longest hand-made stop-motion film ever. The visuals look unreal. You into that kind of animation, or got kids who'd love it?

items.headline: Jenna Ortega as a robot who loves the sun — Taika Waititi's 'Klara and the Sun' lands Friday
items.body: One of the fall's most intriguing films opens Friday (Oct. 23). Taika Waititi directs 'Klara and the Sun,' based on Nobel winner Kazuo Ishiguro's novel, with Jenna Ortega as Klara — a solar-powered 'Artificial Friend' robot who watches the human world with wide-eyed wonder. Amy Adams and Steve Buscemi co-star in a tender, slightly eerie sci-fi drama about love and what it means to be human.
items.say: There's a new Taika Waititi movie Friday — Jenna Ortega plays a kind of sweet robot companion in it. Based on a big literary novel. Looks like a thinker. You go for the sci-fi stuff, or need more of a popcorn movie?

items.headline: A quiet comeback — Michael Kiwanuka's 'FUDGE' arrives Friday after his health scare
items.body: Soul favorite Michael Kiwanuka — the voice behind 'Cold Little Heart,' the Big Little Lies theme — drops his fifth album 'FUDGE' on Friday (Oct. 23), his first since revealing he'd suffered a stroke. He self-produced it for the first time since his debut, and lead single 'Summer Clothes' is warm, hazy, everyday-beauty stuff inspired by his local tailors. Easy, soulful Sunday-morning listening.
items.say: Michael Kiwanuka — that smoky-voiced soul guy who did the Big Little Lies theme — has a new album out Friday, his first since a health scare. The single's gorgeous. You into that mellow soul sound, or stick with what you know?

items.headline: Four years later, 'Cyberpunk: Edgerunners' is back — Season 2 just dropped on Netflix
items.body: A bit of a cult phenomenon returned this week: 'Cyberpunk: Edgerunners' Season 2 hit Netflix (all 10 episodes). The original anime — set in the neon, rain-slicked world of the Cyberpunk 2077 game — became a word-of-mouth smash and even sent players flooding back to the game. The new season is a standalone story with fresh characters, so you can dive in cold. Slick, violent, gorgeous sci-fi.
items.say: That anime 'Cyberpunk: Edgerunners' finally got a second season on Netflix — the first one was a total sleeper hit a few years back. It's a fresh story so you can just jump in. You ever watch any anime, or is that a whole other world to you?
